court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court at Solapur, Divorce Petition No.251/2018
case_name: Mrs. Vidya Ajit Mane vs Mr. Ajit Nagesh Mane
facts_of_case: The wife is seeking transfer of divorce petition filed by husband pending before Family Court at Solapur to Joint Civil Judge, Senior Division at Baramati, District- Pune.

legal_principles.principle: In the interest of justice, a court may transfer a petition to another court.
legal_principles.held: It is very difficult for applicant to travel alone from Baramati to Solapur. Hence, in the interest of justice, this Court be pleased to transfer the divorce petition filed by respondent/husband at Solapur to the Court at Baramati for hearing and final disposal on merits.

legal_principles.principle: A court should not transfer a petition solely for the convenience of one party.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, there is no question of travelling said petition from Solapur to Baramati just for the convenience of wife.

outcome.final_order: The court transferred the divorce petition from Solapur to Baramati for hearing and final disposal on merits.
